steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: I am reasonably certain we have not passed a signpost in the last three miles.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: Four.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Four, then. That is worse, though I appreciate the precision.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: Look at the road. These stones have not been set right in years. Whatever the crown holds out here, it would appear their grasp is not a tight one.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: I had been trying not to notice that. You have a gift for dispelling comfort.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: I have seen neglect of this sort before. When a family leaves their homestead, the road is the first thing to go.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: And what follows the road?

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: Everything else.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: I would not take that fork, were I in your position.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: Why not?

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: The gorge bridge washed out two winters past. No one has troubled to rebuild it. You shall discover that for yourselves if you continue — though ’tis a long way down to learn a short lesson.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Well, its nice to meet such a well-informed stranger on an empty road.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: I have traded these routes for a good many years. Long enough to know which bridges still stand. Where are you bound?

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: A frontier garrison. Past the Thornwood, near the forest’s edge.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: The old outpost? There are not many who head out that way.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: We were told it was still manned. Though, given the state of everything else out here, I am beginning to question the reliability of what we were told.

options.text: You seem surprised. What do you know of it?

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: Surprised is too strong. Let us say... curious. I had not thought the crown remembered that post existed.

options.text: We are reinforcements. Long overdue, by the sound of it.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: Reinforcements. After all this time. Well. Someone in the capital must have found a conscience, or at least a reason.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text:
I am Elara. I trade along these frontier routes. That’s the plan, at least, but there are few along them worth trading with.

The crown is offering concessions to anyone willing to bring commerce back to the borderlands, and I intend to be the first to collect.

As it happens, I am heading the same direction. I can guide you to the outpost.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Then we are in your debt. I am Fenwick. This is {player_name}.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: Reinforcements for a forgotten outpost, armed with a map drawn by someone who has never set foot out here. The crown’s generosity knows no bounds.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text:
(laughs)
We would welcome the company, Elara.
